Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today — really appreciated the context on Acme's search & retrieval pilot. Quick recap from our side: 

- Current pain: high latency on vector search during spikes, cost per query higher than expected for peak traffic
- What we heard you want to validate: consistent p95 latency under 200ms, lower per-token inference cost, and controls for private deployments for sensitive data
- Success criteria for PoC: demo of integrated pipeline (embedding -> reranking -> streaming responses) + baseline perf numbers on our infra

Next steps I propose:
1) Technical deep dive / demo (45 minutes): we’ll show the end-to-end flow, perf benchmarks, and discuss integration points
2) Share proposed mutual action plan and trial timeline after the demo

Can you confirm who from Acme should join the technical call? Also please share 2 blocks of availability (30–60 min windows) next week in PST/ET and I’ll align our engineers. We recommend 45 minutes to allow for Q&A.

I’ll prepare a short agenda and send a calendar invite once we lock a time. Attendees from our side will be me, Camila (solutions engineer), and Lukas (performance engineer).

Thanks — looking forward to continuing this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
